title: Storage key naming prefix inconsistency (colon vs hyphen)
description: Zustand persist keys use two divergent naming conventions: colon prefix (e.g. 'bamendjou:theme', 'bamendjou:chart') and hyphen prefix (e.g. 'bamendjou-settings', 'bamendjou-portfolio-v1'). Grandfathered in production to prevent data loss on existing user devices.
remediation: Do not rename legacy keys; enforce colon prefix for new stores.

title: Absence of active cross-tab StorageEvent sync listener in Zustand stores
description: While browser dispatches StorageEvent on storage change, frontend Zustand stores do not subscribe to window storage events to auto-rehydrate in background tabs. Multi-tab concurrent edits could cause last-write-wins overwrites.
remediation: Document single-operator tab workflow or implement broadcast-channel synchronization in a future enhancement.

title: Plaintext local credentials storage on disk
description: CredentialStore persists broker credentials in plaintext YAML at backend/config/local_credentials.yaml relying on 0600 filesystem permissions rather than encrypted envelopes.
remediation: Architecturally verified as intended behavior for local single-user desktop deployment. In-memory masking via all_masked() prevents accidental frontend/API leak.

title: Dual-engine schema management (Alembic PostgreSQL vs. SQLAlchemy SQLite Base.metadata.create_all)
description: SQLite dev/test databases cannot execute PostgreSQL-specific Alembic migrations and must bootstrap via declarative metadata create_all().
remediation: Architectural separation verified: single Alembic head verified statically; declarative models verified across MainBase, OhlcvBase, and ScanReportBase.
